lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal phase Li₄Pd₄N₄ (reduced formula LiPdN, space group I4/mcm, No. 143) has a 12-atom unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies octahedral Li centers with six N neighbors, octahedral N centers with six Pd neighbors, and tetrahedral Pd centers with four N neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Li octahedra and Pd tetrahedra, as well as edge-sharing between Li octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
